en.text:
Grants the following with <solar/>Fusion Grenades equipped:
• An extra Grenade Charge
• 100% Class Ability Energy on Fusion Grenade Kills
• Passive 20% Additional Base Grenade Ability Recharge Rate

While <solar/>Radiant, in an Empowering Rift, or in a <solar/>Well of Radiance:
• Weapon Kills grant 15% <solar/>Fusion Grenade energy
• Weapon Hits grant 5% <solar/>Fusion Grenade energy (0.4 second cooldown between activations)
